slides.texte_overlay:
Small daily wins that
change your whole year
Ten push-ups after you wake up. It takes one minute, and after a year that's over three thousand push-ups. Your body and your discipline both get stronger.
Ten pages before bed. That's around twelve to fifteen books a year. Few habits change the way you think as much as steady reading.
One glass of water before your coffee. A tiny habit that improves your energy, your skin and your focus without you even noticing.
One message to someone you care about. A friend, a parent, an old colleague. Over a year, your relationships become stronger than ever.
One new thing learned. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and after a year it adds up to hundreds of small lessons.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. After a year it adds up to hundreds of small lessons.

slides.texte_overlay: Ten minutes of tidying every evening. Your home stays calm, your mornings start better and you never lose a weekend to cleaning.
One line in a journal. What went well today. In a year, you'll have a book full of reasons to be proud of yourself. Read it on hard days.
